attchmntText: ICICI Securities Limited has submitted a copy of the Letter of Offer of IIFL Capital Services Limited to the Exchange.
voiceSummary: ICICI Securities Limited, acting as the manager to the open offer, disclosed that 45,35,712 equity shares, constituting 4.53% of the offer size, have been tendered in the open offer escrow demat account. The open offer is for the acquisition of up to 10,01,44,112 fully paid-up equity shares of face value of INR 2 each of IIFL Capital Services Limited by FIH Mauritius Investments Ltd along with HWIC Asia Fund. The tendered shares were received as per the open offer escrow demat account statement from Ventura Securities Limited as at 13:52:50 on November 12, 2026. The equity shares tendered by public shareholders are subject to validation and verification of the submission of a complete set of documents. The number of equity shares tendered may differ from the number of equity shares which will be accepted by the acquirer in the open offer.
